purpose: NVIDIA RTX Spark platform-family and OEM-system records for local LLM inference research.

platforms.quantization_compatibility: FP4/FP8/INT8 and other CUDA/TensorRT-supported low-precision paths are first-class platform targets. GGUF/llama.cpp compatibility should be verified against shipping Windows-on-Arm builds and exact backend versions rather than inferred from CUDA support alone.

llm_positioning.practical_guidance: 128GB unified memory is highly relevant to 70B-class and selected 120B-class low-bit models, but actual usable memory and decode performance depend on bandwidth, runtime overhead and context/KV cache requirements.

platforms.price_note: No stable manufacturer retail price captured as of 2026-08-27.
platforms.availability_note: ASUS now exposes concrete ProArt P14, P16 and GR1X product pages; retail pricing and broad shipment dates remain region-dependent/prelaunch.

llm_suitability.practical_guidance: The 128GB configuration is unusually capable for a laptop and should fit many 70B-class low-bit models plus selected larger models, subject to unified-memory allocation, context and runtime overhead.

deduplication_note: RTX Spark OEM systems are implementations of the shared nvidia-rtx-spark-n1x compute platform and must not be counted as independent accelerator architectures.
